execution_and_stop_rule.after_pass: Run full native ABI/general validation, headline benchmark, physical proof, identity, adversarial generation, and three-seed certification on the exact first passing budget.
execution_and_stop_rule.early_stop: Stop at the first passing nested frequency budget.
execution_and_stop_rule.failure: If parent_frequency_512 fails, close the repaired frequency-reserve branch and preserve all negative evidence. Do not add another frequency cutoff.

claim_boundary: Frequency is a train-only runtime selection heuristic, not a semantic importance score. The lowest passing tested budget is only a bounded frontier point, never a global minimum.
